utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. May we have the appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Joanna Korner and Sebastiaan van Hooydonk for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic, Slobodan Cvijetic, and Ms. Annemarie McNulty, appearing for Stanisic Defence this morning. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Dragan Krgovic, Aleksandar Aleksic, Miroslav Cuskic, and Hamish Collings-Begg for Zupljanin Defence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. And if there is nothing to delay us, may we go into closed session so the witness may be escorted back to the stand, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Yes, could we go into open session, please. So we rise, to reconvene in this courtroom at 9.00 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 7th day of December, 2011, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.50 p.m.,
